signals.summary: Candy and chewing gum prices have climbed 7.7% over the past year, more than double the 3.7% increase in the Consumer Price Index.

signals.summary: Candy sales at convenience stores fell 5% in September, and Hershey’s exec says the company now needs consumers to “show up” in the last days before Halloween.
